chunks.head: on shore
chunks.note: on shore = 在岸上、上岸(与 on board 在船上相对)。
chunks.ex_en: The sailors were happy to be on shore again.
chunks.ex_cn: 水手们很高兴又回到了岸上。

chunks.head: a great deal of
chunks.note: a great deal of + 不可数名词 = 大量的。
chunks.ex_en: She spends a great deal of time reading.
chunks.ex_cn: 她花大量时间读书。

chunks.head: no time to lose
chunks.gloss: 刻不容缓、没时间可耽误
chunks.note: (have) no time to lose = 一刻也不能耽搁。
chunks.ex_en: Hurry, we have no time to lose!
chunks.ex_cn: 快点，我们一刻也不能耽搁！

chunks.head: in vain
chunks.note: in vain = 白白地、没有结果地。
chunks.ex_en: He tried in vain to open the locked door.
chunks.ex_cn: 他想打开那扇锁着的门，却是徒劳。

chunks.head: go to work
chunks.note: go to work (on sth) = 开始动手做某事。
chunks.ex_en: After breakfast he went to work on the broken bike.
chunks.ex_cn: 早饭后他动手修那辆坏了的自行车。

chunks.head: put to sea
chunks.note: put to sea = 船只驶离港口、出海。
chunks.ex_en: The fishing boats put to sea before sunrise.
chunks.ex_cn: 渔船在日出前出海了。

chunks.head: make use of
chunks.note: make use of sth = 加以利用。
chunks.ex_en: We should make use of every chance to practise English.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们应该利用每个机会练英语。

chunks.head: do one's utmost
chunks.note: do one's utmost = 尽最大努力。
chunks.ex_en: I will do my utmost to finish the work on time.
chunks.ex_cn: 我会竭尽全力按时完成工作。

chunks.head: at last
chunks.note: at last = 经过等待或努力后终于。
chunks.ex_en: After hours of walking, we reached the top at last.
chunks.ex_cn: 走了几个小时后，我们终于到了山顶。

chunks.head: abundance of
chunks.note: an abundance of sth = 大量、丰富。
chunks.ex_en: The garden had an abundance of fresh fruit.
chunks.ex_cn: 花园里有大量新鲜水果。

chunks.head: that is to say
chunks.note: that is to say = 用来解释或补充说明。
chunks.ex_en: He is a vegetarian, that is to say, he eats no meat.
chunks.ex_cn: 他是素食者，也就是说，他不吃肉。

chunks.head: give over
chunks.note: give over (doing sth) = 停止、放弃某事;此处 give 非'给'义。
chunks.ex_en: She finally gave over trying to change his mind.
chunks.ex_cn: 她最终放弃了想改变他主意的念头。

chunks.head: in a word
chunks.note: in a word = 概括起来说。
chunks.ex_en: In a word, the trip was a great success.
chunks.ex_cn: 总之，这次旅行非常成功。

chunks.head: piece by piece
chunks.note: piece by piece = 一点一点、逐件地(完成)。
chunks.ex_en: He took the engine apart piece by piece.
chunks.ex_cn: 他把发动机一块一块地拆开。

chunks.head: upon second thoughts
chunks.note: on/upon second thoughts = 重新考虑之后(往往改变主意)。
chunks.ex_en: I wanted to buy it, but upon second thoughts I saved the money.
chunks.ex_cn: 我本想买它，但转念一想还是把钱省下了。

chunks.head: occur to sb
chunks.note: it occurs to sb that … = 某人突然想到;此处 occur 非'发生'义。
chunks.ex_en: It suddenly occurred to me that I had left the keys at home.
chunks.ex_cn: 我突然想到把钥匙落在家里了。

chunks.head: in short
chunks.note: in short = 简要地说。
chunks.ex_en: In short, we need to start again.
chunks.ex_cn: 简言之，我们得重新开始。

chunks.head: lay aside
chunks.note: lay aside = 把…放在一边、暂时不做;此处 lay 非'躺'义。
chunks.ex_en: He laid aside his book and answered the phone.
chunks.ex_cn: 他把书放到一边，去接电话。

chunks.head: now and then
chunks.note: (every) now and then = 时而、间或。
chunks.ex_en: We still meet for coffee now and then.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们偶尔还会一起喝咖啡。

chunks.head: apply oneself to
chunks.note: apply oneself to sth = 专心努力做某事。
chunks.ex_en: If you apply yourself to your studies, you will pass.
chunks.ex_cn: 如果你专心学习，就会通过考试。

chunks.head: take up
chunks.note: take up = 占据(时间或空间);此处非'拿起'义。
chunks.ex_en: The big sofa takes up half the room.
chunks.ex_cn: 那张大沙发占了半个房间。

chunks.head: take notice of
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(took no notice of),故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: The cat took no notice of the barking dog.
chunks.ex_cn: 那只猫对狂吠的狗毫不理会。
